release_notes: Build 116 stops the Autopilot Needs You area blinking by removing the competing one-second task-row rebuild and cleanup loops.
Needs You now counts only tasks that are actually ready for action now; future Related Video, Instagram and other queued work remains scheduled without inflating the current counter.
Start next task and the Needs You counter now use the same actionable-task source, so a non-zero counter no longer opens an empty task wizard.
Needs You remains visually stable while Autopilot continues background work, and status text is only changed when its value really changes.
Build 115 SQLite project protection, restore tools and verified Z: database backups remain included unchanged.
